attack_patterns: Brute force login attempts with failed logins and rejected connections
Privilege escalation via root_shell and hot indicators
Data exfiltration with zero source bytes and high destination bytes
Connection resets using flags RSTO and S3 combined with high error rates
Repeated service access with high same_srv_rate in warezmaster attacks
attack_sophistication_levels: Low: Brute force password guessing with obvious failed login spikes
Medium: Data exfiltration with anomalous byte patterns but no privilege escalation
High: Stealthy U2R privilege escalation with subtle host behavior changes and short duration
Advanced: Multi-vector attacks combining evasion via connection resets and multi-service exploitation
mitigation_strategies: Host-based privilege escalation prevention and monitoring
Service hardening and access control for FTP, Telnet, HTTP, IMAP
Integrated anomaly and signature-based detection systems
Continuous monitoring of connection flags and error rates
detection_approaches: Threshold-based alerting on error rates and failed login counts
Signature matching for known attack patterns (e.g., root_shell=1 & hot≥1)
Multi-feature anomaly detection models capturing subtle correlations
Host behavior profiling focusing on privilege escalation markers
Correlation of connection resets and rejected connections with suspicious activity
